name: Old Mans
description: is an iconic beachfront bar, restaurant, and social hub located right on Batu Bolong Beach. It is well-known for its relaxed surf-centric atmosphere during the day, which transforms into a lively nightlife spot with music and events after sunset.
openingHours: Daily: 12:00 – late (until ~01:00, and often until ~02:00 on Wed/Thu/Sat)
priceRange: Mains from ~Rp 40.000-180.000; cocktails around Rp 85.000; typical dinner/party spend ~Rp 150.000-300.000+
